summary: Circa 1943 Aircraft Warning Service cabin first on Salisbury Potrero in the Los Padres; moved to Black Willow Spring, where it still stands on ranch-leased land.

access.note: Owned by a ranching family who lease the land it sits on (Carey, 2011). No public access found in the sources read; check with the Los Padres National Forest before going.

corrections.current: Salisbury Portero AWS Lookout (now at Black Willow Spring)

corrections.why: Carey and Hike Los Padres both spell the place Potrero; the register uses Portrero; the record's Portero matches neither.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls the Black Willow Spring site nearby, but its two coordinate pairs (original and current) are several kilometres apart; the move is accepted, with no move date.

notes_for_editor: The relocation rests on the register (which gives no move date) and on Carey's 2011 reasoning: a 1950 map showing a building above Salisbury Potrero and none at Black Willow Spring, a 1984 history counting two surviving cabins of that design, one of them there, and one owner's reply. Carey's identification is an inference, so confidence is medium. Open conflict, not resolved: Hike Los Padres (camp survey dated 02-23-2022) describes 'the rustic cabin on Salisbury Potrero' that hikers pass on the Bull Ridge Trail. That may be a different building, or the AWS post may not have been wholly moved. A field check or a Los Padres National Forest source would settle it. The relocated event is omitted because no move date is known and the event schema needs a year. The record's kind 'unknown' is left for an editor; the sources call it a cabin or AWS post. Name: the record's 'Portero' matches neither the register ('Portrero') nor Carey and Hike Los Padres ('Potrero'); a correction is proposed. Access: Carey says a ranching family owns the cabin and leases the land under it, so it is treated as private. The register's photo (credited to the USFS and Craig R. Carey collection) has no URL in the sources read, so no photos were added. The Jackson Cabin name comes from Carey and is not in the register.
